part2.question: Describe a tall building you like or dislike

segments.v: I want to talk about Landmark 72. It is a very tall building in Hà Nội. It is on Phạm Hùng street, near my house. It has 72 floors. It has offices, a hotel, apartments and a shopping mall. There is also a place at the top where people can see the city. The building is tall and it is made of blue glass. At night, it has lights at the top. I like this building because the view from the top is very beautiful. I can see all of Hà Nội. It also shows that Hà Nội is developing fast. In the past, this area had many rice fields. But the traffic around the building is very bad.
